descriptionText:
Note: The job is a remote job and is open to candidates in USA. Cohen Development Group is hiring an entry-level Software Developer to build and maintain applications that support construction operations. The role focuses on streamlining workflows, improving project visibility, and collaborating with engineers and business stakeholders to deliver reliable software.
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain software applications supporting construction operations
Collaborate with senior developers, designers, and project stakeholders to define requirements
Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality
Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and performance issues
Assist in integrating third-party tools and APIs into existing systems
Contribute to technical documentation and user guides
Participate in agile development sprints, planning, and retrospectives
Support deployment and monitoring of applications in production environments
Continuously learn new technologies and best practices to enhance development skills
Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Strong foundation in at least one programming language such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or C#
Understanding of core software development concepts including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
Basic knowledge of databases and SQL or NoSQL data management
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment
Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow within a fast-moving development team
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Interest in or familiarity with construction technology or project management software
Benefits
Remote working environment
Meaningful opportunities for professional growth within a dedicated development group
Company Overview
CDG Maui, Inc. is a General Contractor specializing in pre-development, design, planning and vertical construction. It was founded in undefined, and is headquartered in Kihei, Hawaii, USA, with a workforce of 11-50 employees. Its website is https://cdgmaui.com.
